title_zh: 先记录一周家用电量再比较

scenario.label_zh: 安排家庭用电观察记录
scenario.goal_zh: 承认账单不能单独说明耗电原因，约定一周定时记录电表和取暖使用情况

context_zh: 合租室友看到用电量上升，商量如何先收集可比较的记录而不猜测原因。
author: author-phase07-a

sentences.speaker: Demi
sentences.text: Our electricity consumption went up last month. Do you think the new heater caused it?

sentences.speaker: Paul
sentences.text: It might have contributed, but we were both home more often too.

sentences.speaker: Demi
sentences.text: Then the bill alone won't tell us which change mattered most.

sentences.speaker: Paul
sentences.text: Let's record the meter reading at the same time each evening for a week, along with when the heater is on.

sentences.speaker: Demi
sentences.text: I'll make a shared note. We can look at the pattern before deciding what to change.

sentences.speaker: Paul
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll take the first reading tonight.
